name: RC-B10-0260/2026 – § 12 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text: 12. Calls on the VP/HR, the Council and Member States to make human rights, the release of all political prisoners, an end to executions, and accountability for the victimscore elements of any engagement to end the ongoing war as well as respect for international law by both parties; in this regard, condemns all indiscriminate attacks affecting civilians in Iran, including Israeli and US strikes causing thousands of deaths, including hundreds of children, particularly in the massacre at the school in Minab; deeply regrets the absence of a clear condemnation by VP/HR Kallas; calls for an independent investigation into all attacks against civilians, and full accountability for victims of illegal attacks and state repression;
